newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINN PORT RELOADS MORE CARGO IN FOUR MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: TALLINN PORT RELOADS MORE CARGO IN FOUR MONTHS.

text.p: Tallinn Port reloaded 5.2 million tonnes of goods during the first four months of this year, which is up 10 percent higher than the same period in 1996, the company said on Monday.
"A large part of the rise is in oil products and also in containers," Sandor Liive, finance director, told Reuters.
During the first four months, 1.25 million passengers travelled through Tallinn Port, down from 1.4 million passengers in the same period last year, Liive said.
"We are waiting for visa-free travel to add some passenger flow," he added.
Visa-free travel between Estonia and Finland came force in May 1.
